headline: Yemeni offensive advances as Russia redeploys bombers for Ukraine strike threat
subheadline: Yemeni forces capture Dhubab airport while Saudi air power supports offensive, and Russia moves 13 strategic bombers to Olenya and Belaya for Oct 10 strike
lede: Yemeni government forces, backed by Saudi air power, recaptured Houthi-held areas in Marib and advanced toward the Bab al-Mandab strait, capturing Dhubab and its airport, while rocket barrages struck Riyadh and the Aramco refinery in Jeddah. Simultaneously, IDF eliminated Hamas Nukhba commander Ibrahim Abu Awimer in Nuseirat, central Gaza, as attempted vehicle-ramming attacks occurred in the West Bank without Israeli casualties. In Ukraine, Russia redeployed 10 Tu-95MS and 3 Tu-160 strategic bombers to Olenya and Belaya bases, threatening a massive combined strike by October 10, and a strike on the Northern auto bridge over Dnipro in Kyiv was claimed with Kharkiv suffering five killed and 35 injured in multi-building attacks.

sections.title: Russia Redeploys Bombers for Ukraine Strike
sections.body: Russia claimed a strike on the Northern auto bridge over Dnipro in Kyiv, a key logistics route, while redeploying 10 Tu-95MS and 3 Tu-160 bombers to Olenya and Belaya for a massive combined strike by October 10. Kharkiv was struck, hitting a multi-story building and sewing workshop, killing five and injuring 35. Simultaneous Shahed and Geran-5 attacks targeted Kyiv, Kropyvnytskyi, Dnipro, Vinnytsia, Poltava, Kharkiv, and southern regions. Ukraine-Germany signed 15 defense and energy agreements worth €8.5 billion, including Patriot production and air defense, while Poland deployed a Patriot battery in Lublin voivodeship near the border and formed a new drone brigade.

sections.title: Yemeni Forces Advance Toward Bab al-Mandab Strait
sections.body: Yemeni government forces, supported by Saudi air power, recaptured Houthi-held areas in Marib and advanced toward the Bab al-Mandab strait, capturing Dhubab and its airport. Rocket barrages hit the Saudi capital Riyadh, halting airport operations, and struck the Aramco oil refinery in Jeddah. IDF and Shin Bet eliminated Hamas Nukhba platoon commander Ibrahim Abu Awimer in a strike at Nuseirat, central Gaza. Attempted car-ramming attacks occurred near Bani Naim and Michmash in the West Bank with no Israeli injuries reported.
